name: Registered With Phone
description: An account in some system is registered with this phone number: it is the number on the account's own record. The source is WILDCARD (omitted), like HELD_BY_HUMAN, so any plugin's type can point here without identity_core depending upward on it; keeping the source to the kind of record described is the drawer's job. Written only for a number stated with its country code; a number without one has no node to point at and stays on the account.
